name: rdr2-map
description: Local RDR2 map and extraction pipeline

scripts.install:all: npm ci --prefix backend && npm ci --prefix frontend
scripts.types: npm run types --prefix backend && npm run types --prefix frontend
scripts.lint: eslint backend/src shared scripts && npm run lint --prefix frontend
scripts.test: npm run test:contracts && npm test --prefix backend && python -m unittest discover -s rdr2_extractor/tests
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.check: npm run contracts:check && npm run lint && npm run types && npm test && npm run build && npm run test:e2e
